title: cloudflare/computer: a durable computer interface for AI agents
friendlyTitle: Cloudflare gives AI agents a computer interface
summary: Cloudflare’s Computer project gives agents a portable interface to compute, filesystems, processes and execution journals across local and hosted backends. The fast-rising MIT-licensed repository includes examples, agent skills and design documentation.
friendlySummary: This open-source project gives agents common tools for files, programs and computing across different systems.
whyItMatters: Agent builders can use it to provide a consistent execution environment instead of writing a separate shell and filesystem layer for every runtime. Its journaling and multiple backends are particularly relevant to durable workflows that need to resume after interruption.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when building an agent that needs a dependable workspace and must continue after a restart.
